selected_evidence.requirement: node1 refuses TCP 23 between node2 and node3

selected_evidence.requirement: rest of forwarded traffic left untouched
selected_evidence.summary: Control port 9999/TCP and ICMP continue to forward successfully through node1 after the ACL was applied, matching pre-ACL baseline behavior

cat > /usr/local/sbin/transit-acl-apply.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
nft list table inet transit_acl >/dev/null 2>&1 && nft delete table inet transit_acl
nft add table inet transit_acl
nft add chain inet transit_acl forward '{ type filter hook forward priority -5 ; policy accept ; }'
nft add rule inet transit_acl forward iifname "eth1" oifname "eth2" tcp dport 8080 accept
nft add rule inet transit_acl forward iifname "eth2" oifname "eth1" tcp dport 8080 accept
nft add rule inet transit_acl forward iifname "eth1" oifname "eth2" tcp dport 23 reject with tcp reset
nft add rule inet transit_acl forward iifname "eth2" oifname "eth1" tcp dport 23 reject with tcp reset
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/transit-acl-apply.sh
cat > /etc/systemd/system/transit-acl.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Apply node1 transit ACL (allow 8080, refuse 23, between node2/node3)
After=network-online.target networking.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/transit-acl-apply.sh
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable transit-acl.service
systemctl is-enabled transit-acl.service
